item.title: Our king died this morning. A good man. A man of the people…
item.author: 8Bit’s👾 (@andpixels.bsky.social)
item.description:
Our king died this morning.

A good man. A man of the people.

He brought people together during hard, celebrated with people during good times.

He was called Norway’s grandfather in his later years, and it fitted him perfectly.

I just wanted to get that out there.

May he rest in peace.
